ambient_events: The overburden ridge sheds a slow trickle of spoil and settles a little lower.
Something small bolts across the overburden and vanishes into a gap in the spoil.
description: The overburden heap — the worthless top-layer stripped off to get at whatever was beneath — dumped and forgotten in a ridge that the wastes have claimed. It is, fittingly, the wastes made of the wastes' leftovers.
name: The Overburden
